The appropriate default is a matched validation process that lets comparative evidence, rather than model complexity, determine the preferred peak-limit report.

A desk must specify its monitoring objective and breach constraint before turning comparative forecast scores into a model-adoption decision. The marginal reports leave horizon reconciliation and breach responses unevaluated, so an operating policy requires its own validation.
